0109.name: USB_MEDIA_WRITE_PROTECTED
0109.message:
Data could not be saved.
The USB storage device
is write-protected.
Please refer to the manual for the
device and disable write-protection.
0109.short_description: The USB storage device is write-protected.
0109.long_description: The USB storage device is write-protected, or the console is unable to write to the device for other reasons. This could be a dirty port or faulty adapter.
0109.short_solution: Disable write-protection on the USB storage device.
0109.long_solution: Disable write-protection on the USB storage device. If it is disabled, you may need to clean the console's USB port(s) or purchase a new adapter or USB storage device.
